initialExam.title: UPSC CAPF (AC) 2026
initialExam.description: Central Armed Police Forces (Assistant Commandant) exam for BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, and SSB. Exam scheduled July 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: General Ability & Intelligence (250 marks). Paper-II: General Studies, Essay, Comprehension (200 marks).
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 125 questions, 250 marks, 2 hours (Objective). Paper-II: Descriptive (Essay, Comprehension, Precis), 200 marks, 3 hours. PET + Medical.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → PET/Medical → Interview → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant Commandant in BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, SSB
initialExam.careerGrowth: AC → Deputy Commandant → Commandant → DIG → IG → ADG → DG.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Uniform Allowance, Ration Allowance, Medical, Government quarters
